content:
A beta version of *Fallout 76*, the B.E.T.A. (Break-it Early Test Application), was available to those who pre-ordered the game.

The beta began on October 23 for Xbox One and on October 30 for PC and PS4. Player progress made during the beta was carried over into the full game. Active periods for the beta were scheduled as followed.
